method: Read primary publication / author-hosted arXiv pages through web lookup; no secondary summaries used as technical evidence.
scope: Only the specific claims listed here were checked; not a claim to independently reproduce or review every result in the cited papers.
experiment_evidence: All course experiment numbers are generated by experiment.py and saved in outputs; cited paper performance values are not used as course results.

sources.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
sources.checked_material: Author arXiv abstract and HTML sections 4.1 and 4.2
sources.verified_claim: The early LLaVA architecture uses a trainable projection to map visual features into language embedding width; training stages differ in updated modules.
sources.course_use: Projection-interface reading; no LLaVA weights or instruction data are used.

sources.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
sources.checked_material: Author arXiv abstract and HTML sections 2.1/2.2
sources.verified_claim: Flamingo uses a visual resampler and newly trained gated cross-attention modules to condition a frozen language model on visual features.
sources.course_use: Cross-attention connection example; course implements only a tiny single-head classifier, not Flamingo.

sources.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
sources.verified_claim: BLIP-2 bridges frozen pretrained image encoders and language models with a lightweight Querying Transformer trained in two stages.
sources.course_use: Further reading on query-based interfaces; no numerical comparison with BLIP-2.

sources.title: OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework
sources.verified_claim: OFA frames diverse cross-modal and unimodal tasks in a sequence-to-sequence framework.
sources.course_use: Unified-interface reading; the course does not train an OFA or unified Transformer model.

sources.title: Making the V in VQA Matter: Elevating the Role of Image Understanding in Visual Question Answering
sources.checked_material: Author arXiv abstract and metadata; first submission 2016, revised 2017
sources.verified_claim: The study counteracts language priors with complementary image pairs yielding different answers to the same question.
sources.course_use: Motivates visual-necessity checks and language-only baselines; the course uses original synthetic data.
